entries.description: A 40-acre farm in Shelby, Michigan, owned and worked by one lesbian, offering camping space for visitors and welcoming women, children, and known men.
entries.raw_text: JAN F WALSH Two Towers, 201 S 132nd Ave, Shelby, MI 49455 (616)861-4939. I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat. I raise animals and have a . 1 acre garden. I welcome visitors, especially lesbians as I am quite isolated, but I do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin. There is camping space galore. If the visit is over 1 night I ask for a $2 fee (I trade)/night per person to defray my costs (water, toilet paper, produce, etc). Drugs in moderation are fine. No proselytizing please. Extended visits (over 1 week) need to be decided in person. I welcome: girl and boy children, nonlesbian women, (males). I have/am: 1 lesbian, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing (cold running water only)/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land as it is owned and lived on by one woman ('I own a farm, live on it and work it somewhat'). Residents is 1 ('1 lesbian'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women ('especially lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'), and Gay men and Non-gay men ('(males)', 'do not forbid males of any age access IF known to me or with wimmin'). Focus is Farming/self-sufficiency ('I raise animals and have a . 1 acre garden').

entries.description: An 80-acre women's land cooperative and farm with woods and camping in West Central Wisconsin, home to 4 year-round residents, welcoming new members, girl children, boy children under 2, and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: WISCONSIN WOMYN'S LAND CO-OP Rt 2 Box 42, Norwalk, WI 54648 (608)269-5301. WWLC owns DOE (Daughters of Earth) Farm; half wooded campground, half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc in West Central Wisconsin. The land is hilly, secluded, very beautiful. Four womyn live here year 'round, more in summer. Some of the campground chemical free space. Camping equipment available if needed. Sliding scale fees. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, boy children 'til age of 2, nonlesbian women. We have/are: 175 members almost all lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as it is an established cooperative with 4 year-round residents ('Four womyn live here year 'round') and 175 members. Land address inferred from rural route mailing address. Accepted groups include Lesbian women ('almost all lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), and Boy children with age restriction ('boy children 'til age of 2'). Focuses include Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Some of the campground chemical free space') and Farming/self-sufficiency ('half hayfield, orchard, garden, berries, etc').

entries.description: An 80-acre land space with two resident lesbians creating a chemically free space focused on interdependent care and healing, offering primitive camping and welcoming differently abled women and children by arrangement.
entries.raw_text: THE WEB c/o Lanning, Box 8742, Minneapolis, MN 55408 (612)983-2289. We are consciously creating a space in which to live our lesbian reality in harmony with the natural world. Primitive camping here is open to wimmin. We hope to build a community focused on interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all. Chemically free, no pets, no guns, no men. We welcome: girl and boy children by arrangement, differently abled. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 80 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land, women living on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('We have/are: 2 lesbians... women living on the land'), as only 2 lesbians live there and they do not explicitly recruit new residential members on their welcome list. Land location is not specified beyond a Minneapolis PO box. Accepted groups are Lesbian women ('our lesbian reality'), Girl children, and Boy children ('girl and boy children by arrangement'); men are explicitly forbidden ('no men'). Focuses are Disabled women ('differently abled', 'interdependent care toward the healing and health of us all') and Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Chemically free').

entries.description: A 40-acre vacation ranch in Ronan, Montana, offering tipi lodgings and campsites for lesbians and gay men on holiday, with some women-only weeks, run by two resident lesbians.
entries.raw_text: NORTH CROW VACATION RANCH RR 1, Box 62-A, Ronan, MT 59864 (406)676-5169. A new social alternative for lesbians and gay men on holiday. Tipi lodgings ($11/night) or campsite ($7/night). Some weeks are for womyn only. We provide food service ($11/night), hot tub, sports facilities, firewood and basic conveniences. Close by: swimming, boating, etc. Reservations preferred. We welcome: girl and boy children, gay males. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 40 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space as it is a vacation ranch for visitors on holiday. Land address inferred from rural route mailing address. Residents is 2 ('2 lesbians... women living and working on the land'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women ('lesbians'), Girl children and Boy children ('girl and boy children'), and Gay men ('gay males', 'gay men on holiday').

entries.description: A 90-acre piece of land with woods and meadows owned by four lesbians planning an intentional community focused on solar technology and the female principle, currently living off-land and welcoming new members.
entries.raw_text: REBECCA, SUSAN, ANNE & MAURINE 4026 Anderson SE, Albuquerque, NM 87108 (505)268-1863. The land is a combination of woods, meadows, and rocky bluffs. We have a creek and springs. Long-term plans include: cabins for our personal use, additional cabins and camping sites for use by visiting women (by pre-arrangement only), and some farming. Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology and on developing a place that nurtures the female principle. We welcome: new members/resident. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 90 acres, camping space, woods.
entries.notes: Community name taken from opening names. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as 4 lesbians are organizing a community on 90 acres and actively recruiting ('We welcome: new members/resident'). Residents is 0 because cabins are only in 'Long-term plans... for our personal use' and the contact address is in the city of Albuquerque. Land state NM inferred from Albuquerque mailing address. Focuses are Environmentalism/eco-friendly ('Emphasis on solar and appropriate technology') and Spirituality/ritual ('nurtures the female principle'). Accepted groups is Lesbian women ('4 lesbians', directory context).

entries.description: A 167-acre women's land collective 2 hours north of San Francisco, seeking 2 lesbian-feminists to form a new group to take over the land, substance-free and focused on building living space and relationships.
entries.raw_text: YORKVILLE WOMEN'S LAND COLLECTIVE c/o Annie, 50 Balmy, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)285-5145. YWLC seeking 2 lesbian-feminists for new group. Old group (save one) needs to sell. Lots of land 2 hours north of SF. Needs committment, money and respect. Into building living space, relationship, feminism. Not into drug abuse or S&M. Send name, address and phone for full details. Issues & money still negotiable. We welcome: new members, loans. We have/are: 6 lesbians, 167 acres, camping space, woods and meadows, farm land (grazing).
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative as it is an established collective seeking new members to reorganize. Land city Yorkville inferred from community name; land state CA inferred from '2 hours north of SF'. Num_residents is blank because 'women living on the land' is not checked or stated. Focus is Recovery/substance-free ('Not into drug abuse'). Accepted groups is Lesbian women ('lesbian-feminists', '6 lesbians').

entries.description: A privately owned 500-acre ranch near the Russian River in Northern California open June through September for camping and events, with horses boarded, welcoming women and children under 10.
entries.raw_text: THE RANCH c/o Helen Wagner, 440 Holladay, San Francisco, CA 94110 (415)824-5352. Privately Woman owned land open to camping and events June-Sept. Horses boarded, workers welcomed. Daily and weekly rates and special event rates $5/day and up. We welcome: new members, girl children, boy children under 10, nonlesbian women, dogs, horses. We have/are: 500 acres, housing/permanent structures limited to workers, plumbing, outhouses, camping space, woods, farm land, cook out grills, creek on land, near Russian River, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land ('Privately Woman owned land'). Land state CA inferred from 'near Russian River'. Num_residents is left blank because although 'women living and working on the land' is checked, no number of women is given. Accepted groups include Lesbian women (directory context, welcomes new members), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), Girl children ('girl children'), and Boy children with restriction ('boy children under 10').

entries.land_location_as_stated: located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean
entries.description: A women's community and retreat on 60 acres near Elk, California, with 8 resident lesbians, looking for permanent members especially lesbians over 50, and welcoming girl children and possibly non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, AC 95432. A thriving womyn's community and retreat located 3 hours north of SF and close to the ocean. 160 acres of redwood-covered slopes, open grassy meadows, waterfalls, and pools for reflection. Nine structures including a communal kitchen, guesthouse, and bath house, look out over surrounding valleys and hills. A vegetable and flower garden, an herb garden, and an orchard. We began as an older womyn's community. We are now womyn of diverse ages, races and backgrounds, looking for permanent members (especially lesbians over 50). Visitors $5/night (exceptions: working class/older/third world women). We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women (possibly). We have/are: 8 lesbians, 60 acres, 10 housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity with generator, camping space, woods, farm land, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Contact state 'AC' in raw text corrected to CA in contact_state and land_state. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it names community first ('community and retreat') and has 8 resident lesbians seeking permanent members. Acreage coded as 60 per rule to record smaller number when two figures given (160 in narrative, 60 in questionnaire). Residents is 8 ('8 lesbians... women living and working on the land'). Land address matches road mailing address. Focuses are Older women ('older womyn's community', 'especially lesbians over 50'), Working-class women ('working class... women' fee exception), and Women of color ('third world women' fee exception, 'womyn of diverse... races'). Accepted groups include Lesbian women, Girl children ('girl children'), and Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women (possibly)').
